title: A Survey of Bargmann Invariants: Geometric Foundations and Applications
summary: Bargmann invariants, a class of unitary-invariant quantities arising from the overlaps of quantum state vectors, provide a profound and unifying framework for understanding the relative geometry of the projective Hilbert space. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of their theoretical characterization and practical applications, with particular emphasis on recent progress in determining the full structure of their admissible set. The core of this review demonstrates how these invariants serve as a powerful tool for characterizing the intrinsic geometry of the space of quantum states,…
